<fidel-lang>

Language for one section. Switch language for one section, not the whole page; each button is written in its own language.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners who mix Amharic and English, and Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, Somali and Arabic readers.

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

In this lesson you build one simple web page and check it with a screen reader.

በዚህ ትምህርት አንድ ቀላል ድረ-ገጽ ትሠራላችሁ፤ ከዚያም በስክሪን አንባቢ ትፈትሹታላችሁ።

Barnoota kana keessatti fuula weebii salphaa tokko ijaarta.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-lang label="Lesson summary">
  <div lang="en">…</div>
  <div lang="am">…</div>
</fidel-lang>

Source: player/src/components/b/section-lang.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-lang>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
labeltextnoneName of the section.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-lang>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-lang-change{ lang }Another language was chosen.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • One real button per version; the current one has aria-current="true". "Showing Amharic" is announced.
  • The choice is remembered. Arabic gets dir="rtl".

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Content in English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Tigrinya, Somali or Arabic; its own buttons follow ui-lang.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 3.1.2 Language of Parts: Each button and each version has its own lang.
  • 1.3.2 Meaningful Sequence: Arabic gets dir="rtl".

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
